verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Jira has APIs: a bare 'Rich APIs' marketing line and community mentions of REST queries and API wrapper scripts. Nothing documents an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and probes for an OpenAPI spec at standard developer.atlassian.com paths all returned 404. Having an API is a related but different capability from an interactive, runnable reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
